thread:
maria: audit-bot alerted: spike in KMS DecryptErrors for gateway-apac since 02:10 UTC. mTLS handshakes failing across edge proxies — ~120 errors/min. Anyone touch keystore RBAC?

audit-bot: ALERT: KMS_DECRYPT_FAIL service=gateway-apac count=128 since=02:10 UTC sample_err=AccessDenied: key unwrap denied (iam:PassRole)

jon: I rolled a RBAC tightening yesterday 22:40 to remove a cross-ns binding for keystore access. I thought it only affected staging namespaces — might've clipped prod gateway SA.

sre-oncall: On it. I can repro a handshake fail locally: `curl https://gateway-apac.internal/health` -> TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure). Captured proxy logs showing "client: unwrap failed".

kevin: KMS client logs confirming: "AccessDeniedException: iam:PassRole for serviceAccount:gateway/sa-gateway". Looks like rolebinding for 'kms-access' in namespace 'gateway' is missing.

jon: ugh, my bad — the terraform plan applied a narrower scope and removed the ns binding. Rolling back RBAC now.

jon: ```
# check current binding
kubectl -n gateway get rolebinding keystore-access -o yaml
# reapply backfill
kubectl -n gateway apply -f keystore-rolebinding-backfill.yaml
```

deploy-bot: rollback started: keystore-rolebinding-backfill applied to apac-1 (job id: rb-2026-03-20-42)

maria: After backfill, KMS decrypt rate dropping, mTLS handshakes recovering. Errors down from ~120/min to ~7/min over 4m.

sre-oncall: Confirmed: unwrap succeeded, gateway proxies report established TLS sessions and KV cache warm. Marking incident as mitigated for now.

alice: Postmortem action items: add CI guard to detect removal of namespace-scoped rolebindings for keystore SAs; add runbook step to query `KMS DecryptErrors` metric and correlate with proxy handshake failures; add an automated rollback play for RBAC diffs.

kevin: Ops/Config note: we should enforce TLS1.3 only on edge and backend-to-backend lanes, but ensure proxies have a short-term graceful fallback to avoid total outage on unwrap issues. Also schedule a canary to validate KMS unwrap permissions across regions after any RBAC TF change.

maria: I'll open an RFC and owner the CI check + monitoring alert (KMS DecryptErrors > 10/min per region). Thanks for fast triage everyone. :thumbsup:

jon: sorry again, will be more careful with TF scopes. tagging follow-ups into #eng-infra.

sre-oncall: adding timeframe: incident opened 02:11 UTC, mitigated 02:18 UTC. Logging this for postmortem.

maria: filing postmortem draft now and will include timeline + commands + config snippets.

alice: also adding a small integration test to deploy pipeline: `kubectl -n gateway run --rm curl-test --image=curlimages/curl -- curl -sS https://gateway-apac.internal/health` to validate TLS+unwrap flows during canaries.

maria: closing thread here, will ping when RFC + PMs are live.
